# Documentation Instructions

- Keep design documents concise, structured, and implementation-oriented.
- Prefer explicit rules and acceptance criteria over long narrative text.
- Use the same terminology consistently: delivery, core, infrastructure, tenant_id, Valkey, upstream.
- When describing flows, separate allowed and denied paths clearly.
- Keep control-plane API language distinct from data-plane proxy behavior.
